findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed the only hand sink in the kitchen to be obstructed with a pitcher and box of single-service items. The staff were informed that hand sinks must be accessible at all times of food preparation and service. The sink was cleared during the inspection. Ensure this sink remains available at all times to incentivize staff to wash hands regularly.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a bag of hot dogs in the chest cooler to not be date marked. Discussed with PIC, and PIC date marked the bag of hot dogs. Ensure opened food items are date marked within 24 hours of opening and kept for only 7 days thereafter.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17(B) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Date Marking. (B) Except as specified in (E) - (G) of this section, refrigerated, READY-TO-EAT TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD prepared and PACKAGED by a FOOD PROCESSING PLANT shall be clearly marked, at the time the original container is opened in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and if the FOOD is held for more than 24 hours, to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded, based on the temperature and time combinations specified in (A) of this section and: (1) The day the original container is opened in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be counted as Day 1; and (2) The day or date marked by the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT may not exceed a manufacturer’s use-by date if the manufacturer determined the use-by date based on FOOD safety.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Upon inspector arrival, a watering can was being held in the hand washing sink.  Discussed with PIC and employees.  Ensure the hand washing sink is not used for anything other than handwashing.

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The caulk along the 3 part sink is cracked and coming apart along most of the surface.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure sink is recaulked to create a smooth, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent surface.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text:
750.540 (C) The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.

New FDA food code states a certified food protection manager must be on site during all hours of food prep/operation. Discussed requirement with person in charge.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14  (Pf) Test kits or other devices are not available to the employees to measure sanitizing solution concentration. Provide a test kit or other measuring device so the employees can measure concentrations and ensure proper sanitization. Avoid a concentration of sanitizer that is too high, which can be toxic. Reference 4-302.14.

No test strips available to test concentration of sanitizer in 3 compartment sink. Discussed with person in charge. She is purchasing new strips.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the interior of the microwave to be soiled with food splash. Clean the microwave.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed single service containers stored with the food contact surface exposed. Store all single service containers in a way to prevent the food contact surface being exposed. The single service containers were properly stored during the inspection to correct the violation.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
CORRECTED: Observed single service nacho containers food contact surface exposed. Store single service containers inverted downward to prevent contimination.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed sinks in women's restroom with cracked caulking along the sink-wall joint. Strip and re-caulk the wall-sink joint to make smooth and easily cleanable.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed bottom of microwave oven covered in pretzel salt and food debris. Clean this at least once daily or as needed.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Acoustic tiles are present in both restrooms.  Some tiles have been changed to smooth/cleanable tiles in men's room.  UPON NEXT REMODEL - change all acoustic tiles to smooth/cleanable tiles.
750-1210(b) Walls and ceilings in walk-in refrigeration units, food prepartion areas, equipment washing areas, and toilet rooms shall be smooth, light-cored, non-absorbant, and easily cleanable. Concrete or pumice block in these locations shall be finished and sealed to provide a cleanable surface.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
See previous inspection report.

750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
A six to eight inch stack of sliced cheese was found in refrigerator without date of opening.  Manager was unsure how long cheese had been within refrigerator.  CORRECTED - cheese was immediately, voluntarily discarded.  See HACCP topic for more information.

750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment:
Mouse droppings were found in the following locations:
(a) along left side of black employee refrigerator, 
(b) along the sides, and underneath, the white freezer and refrigerator, 
(c) on floor under shelves on both sides of storage room, and behind storage room door, 
(d) under hand sink cabinet, along both sides of grease trap.
Zoo pest control operator made bi-monthly visit to facility within last few weeks.  No report was left with staff.  
Thoroughly clean and sanitize these areas, and monitor for new pest activity.  Should evidence of pests continue to be found, work with pest control operator to eliminate pests.  Will follow-up in 30 days.

750-1160 Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
[1] South outer doors have gap between the two doors, along the bottom of the vertical seam.
[2]  North outer doors have gaps along the bottom of both doors, as well as a gap along the vertical seam between them.
Seal these doors so they are tight-fitting, and no daylight is shining through, to eliminate potential entrance of pests.

750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Acoustic tiles are present in both restrooms.  Some tiles have been changed to smooth/cleanable tiles in men's room.  UPON NEXT REMODEL - change all acoustic tiles to smooth/cleanable tiles.

750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.
